facts.fact: The PPDA reports that 562 tenders have been published on MANePS to date and 560 procurement notices recorded, as of 5 October 2026.
The PPDA reports MANePS had 7,417 registered suppliers, 216 of 250 targeted 2026/27 procurement plans published (86 percent), 560 procurement notices and 562 tenders as of 5 October 2026.
